title: Services
description: What we do for you when the template alone is not enough.

props.title: Services that get your site live
props.subtitle: From a two-hour review to a full redesign. We pick the smallest scope that solves your problem.

props.title: What we offer
props.subtitle: Four ways to work together, from the lightest to the most involved.

items.title: Technical review
items.description: Two hours over your current site: performance, accessibility and SEO, with an actionable report.

items.title: Setup
items.description: We install the template, adapt it to your brand and leave you publishing within a week.

items.title: Custom theme
items.description: Your identity turned into tokens, so every component inherits it with no exceptions.

items.title: Ongoing support
items.description: A direct channel and regular reviews while your team learns the system.

props.title: We start from the problem, not the design
props.content: Before touching a colour we want to know who you are speaking to and what should happen when someone lands on the page.

items.title: Understand
items.description: A short session to pin down the goal and the real constraints.

items.title: Build
items.description: Short iterations with something visible at the end of each.

items.title: Hand over
items.description: You keep control: the content is files in your repository.

props.content: And when we are done, you are not dependent on us.

items.title: No hidden dependencies
items.description: Everything we use is open and documented.

items.title: Documentation included
items.description: We write down how to change each thing, not just what we did.

items.title: Team training
items.description: A final session so your team can carry on unaided.
